fields.label: Component
fields.description: Which part of the DUPA build-up this line is. Additive per D-028: the three components sum, and OCM, profit and VAT are applied to that sum.

fields.label: Basis
fields.description: Where this quantity and rate came from -- a DPWH schedule item, a measured quantity, a quotation. A reviewer asking 'where did this come from' should get an answer per line, not one unexplained total.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: quantity x rate, computed on the parent so every line is derived the same way rather than typed.
